strategy: new approved run from the corroborated completed terminal snapshot; not legacy resume
rationale: The accepted prefix is byte-bound and unambiguously parses into 79 contiguous legacy JSON objects.
Legacy framing, actor omissions, and wall-clock regression remain explicit limitations; no old record or approval is repaired or reused.
The matching completed terminal snapshot permits a new workflow, not a manual override of an active run.
Only the newly appended, schema-valid suffix is used to derive this remediation run's materialized state.
controls: Verify the anchor and contiguous suffix before every append.
Stop on concurrent writes, incomplete framing, unexpected identifiers, or snapshot mismatch.
Do not claim strict historical JSONL/current-schema conformance.
Obtain fresh authority for any external/destructive/privileged action.
checkpointRepair: The first approved item repairs checkpoint collection before post-item checkpoints; this is not -Resume and no failed checkpoint is labeled valid.
